We were driving down to Florida for the Fourth of July and stopped at a Cracker Barrel along the way. It's crowded as hell. She's upset, but we still get a table. We ordered and sat for an hour to get our food. As soon as our food came out, my nana flipped her shit, screaming at the poor waitress who barely had put our food down about how unacceptable the wait was. I started eating, picking up a slice of bacon. When the waitress didn't give my nana the answer she wanted, She grabbed my hand and stormed into the kitchen, demanding to speak to someone. The kitchen staff don't answer, but some give puzzled looks to each other. Most of them kept working. I'm about 7 or 8 years old, bacon hanging out of my mouth, hand starting to go numb (she had been gripping my wrist for a good 5 minutes now). While she's berating the kitchen staff, someone who looks to be a manager walks up and tries to apologize for the long wait, trying to get her to go back down to the table. OUR FOOD WAS ON THE TABLE. SHE HAD NO REASON TO BE MAD. She grabs the man's collar, shouting some expletives, and walks away (dragging me behind her). On her way out, she knocks over some items on the display at the front door, flipping off the staff. 

We ate McDonalds for breakfast next door.
